text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
By the way~, Trainer.
There's a little something I just remembered, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san, remember when you visited
Yukoma Onsen the other day?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I gave you some hot spring mineral crystals, didn't I?
Yeah, I gave you some hot spring mineral deposits, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why did they go out of their way to buy it?
I wonder if something happened?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to ask around
about Yukoma Onsen's mineral hot spring deposits.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: "Yunohana...? Ah, the hot spring crystals of Yukoma Onsen are—"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
It's a little local specialty that works wonders on the body.
Especially for physical and mental fatigue, or chronic cold sensitivity.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho~ For mental and physical fatigue, you say.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute-saaaan! Tarumae—!
I came to play—!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, Rickey-chan.
Thanks for coming by."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Feng Shui Umamusume, Copano Rickey,
came over to hang out.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rickey, didn't you say you found something out
about Espo-san?
Since you're roommates in the dorm, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The reason Acute-san and Espo-san
wanted hot spring mineral crystals is—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Apparently it's for her mother! Espo-san's mother is a bit sickly, you see...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So, it looks like she's gathering all sorts of healthy things and sending them to her mom!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I gave them a few of my recommended
feng shui goods as presents too♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui goods... Geez, Rickey,
that's all you ever buy...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see. So the reason Espo-san wanted
those mineral bath salts was for her mother, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... Trainer-san,
I've got a great idea.
choice_data_list: Acute, what do you mean by something good...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How about we give Espo-san
a whole bunch of souvenirs from Yukoma Onsen as a gift?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Wild mountain greens, udon, and herbal tea!
I'm sure they'll love it~.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see, an assortment of local specialties?
I think that's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, in that case,
we'll help you pack, too♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the four of them decided
to put together a care package, but—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho~ Packing presents really is so much
fun. I packed quite a lot, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I'd like to give them a little something extra.
I wonder what would be good?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san!
My recommendation is this folding fan☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's a super lucky and happy color!
If you place this in the "Yan Nian" direction,
great fortune is guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rickey, you need to think a bit more
about the person receiving the gift.
You should have included some fluffy socks or something...
choice_data_list: Trying to do all of that at once... might be impossible...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally, not all of it will fit.
As I ponder what to do..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer! This is it, this right here!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'd love to give them this bath bucket and washcloth set. I'm sure they'll be able to use it for a loooong time.
choice_data_list: A big shot like that is a bit much, even for me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand your feelings, but looking at the remaining capacity, there's no way it will fit.
We'll just have to ask them to give it up...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is there really... no way?
I just really wanna bring joy
to Espo-san's mother, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I thought this would make bath time fun, though...
Uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I don't want to see Wonder Acute looking sad. What I thought of after considering that was—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer, this car is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoooo, this is amazing~
I can pile up as much as I want~
Bath basins, folding fans, socks, and all~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd come up with a method like this...
Trainer, you're amazing, and I'm so grateful.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's great, Acute-san!
Alright then, everyone, let's get ready
for the Happy Truck Express!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the four of them happily loaded up
the gifts to be sent to Espoir City.
